backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing access‑controlled user profiles and cricket match management with teams, innings, balls, and match creation/start logic.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files, components, and tests with high‑confidence evidence entries.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing roles of various frontend files including pages, hooks, components, and global styles.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions defining OKLCH color system and global background/foreground styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that loads the React app root and main.tsx module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps all pages in AppLayout, AppErrorBoundary, ThemeProvider, and global Toaster.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component that logs errors and renders a recovery UI with reset navigation.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Responsive header showing branding, connectivity status, home navigation, and login/logout actions using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Overall page layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with responsive spacing.
frontend/src/components/BackendCanisterI: Dialog component explaining backend canisters, offline mode, and backend-unavailable behavior.
frontend/src/components/ConnectivityStat: Displays online/offline status with reason and links to backend info dialog using connectivity hook.
frontend/src/components/DeleteMatchConfi: Confirmation dialog for deleting a match, including backend deletion warning when applicable.
frontend/src/components/mobile/MobileSaf: Mobile-friendly dialog content wrapper with constrained height and scrollable inner area.
Mobile-optimized select dropdown content with limited height and scrolling.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Dialog prompting the user to enter and save their profile name through a backend mutation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts: Tracks network status and probes backend availability to determine online/offline state and reason.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing login, stored identities, and auth-client lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalMatchIntegrit: Checks integrity of locally stored matches and exposes corrupted entries with retry support.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for user profiles and matches, handling offline mode, local storage, and backend syncing.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollIntoViewOnFo: Hook that scrolls an element into view when it receives focus, with a slight delay.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnsavedOfflineChan: Hook that warns users before leaving a page with unsynced offline changes and provides a navigation confirmation helper.
frontend/src/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode styles, and mobile overflow/touch adjustments.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point setting up React Query, Internet Identity, and rendering the main App component.
frontend/src/offline/localMatchStore.ts: Local storage manager for offline match data with save, load, list, and integrity-check utilities and error handling.
Provides structured logging and user-facing messages for offline storage errors.
frontend/src/offline/serialization.ts: Serializes and deserializes match-related data to JSON, handling BigInt and nested structures for local storage.
frontend/src/pages/InningsSummaryPage.ts: UI page showing innings summary, batting stats, and allowing starting the next innings with offline support.
frontend/src/pages/LiveScoringPage.tsx: Live scoring interface that loads match data, tracks striker/bowler state, records balls, and manages dialogs for wickets, extras, and bowler selection with offline support.
Dashboard listing matches with navigation, deletion, integrity checks, and offline/local-only match handling.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSetupPage.tsx: Form-driven match creation page where users configure overs, teams, players, and starting positions before starting a match.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSummaryPage.tsx: Displays completed match results, team scores, and detailed innings scorecards with offline mode awareness.
frontend/src/utils/parseMatchId.ts: Validates and parses match ID strings into bigint values with error reporting.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL or session-stored parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind config enabling dark mode, custom color system, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file defining schema version, app summary, issues, and feature metadata for the cricket scoring app.
